Insight: New customers have significantly higher churn risk.
Recommendation: Strengthen onboarding and retention programs during the first 6 months.

Insight: Month-to-month contracts have the highest churn rate.
Recommendation: Provide incentives to move customers toward longer-term contracts.

Insight: Customers with higher monthly charges show higher churn.
Recommendation: Offer personalized pricing plans and service bundles.

Insight: Electronic check customers have a high churn rate.
Recommendation: Encourage automatic payment methods through targeted incentives.

Insight: Customers without Tech Support show higher churn.
Recommendation: Promote Tech Support packages to customers at higher churn risk.

Insight: Customers without Online Security show higher churn.
Recommendation: Promote Online Security packages to vulnerable customers.

Insight: A high-risk segment of new, high-paying, month-to-month customers was identified.
Recommendation: Prioritize this segment for proactive retention campaigns.
